items.title: Mona Hinton interviewed by Milt Fillius and Michael Woods, Scottsdale, Arizona, March 4, 1995
items.q: But this was one time he was right. He really hadn’t thrown the spitball, and I’m not going to go into detail to explain who did throw it, because he never admitted that he threw it, but everyone knew who it was. Yeah, and Cab and Dizzy had this little scuffle and Dizzy stuck his knife in Cab’s leg,

ctx.x: I understand Dizzy and Cab had an altercation. Can you tell us that story?

Well, it seemed that they had a little group called the, what was the name of it Cab Jivers. And they would come out and perform. And Dizzy and — I really should let Milton tell that story because he knows the details of it more. But I can remember because a spitball fell in the spotlight. And Cab accused Dizzy of throwing the spitball. And Dizzy was always doing something wrong. But this was one time he was right. He really hadn’t thrown the spitball, and I’m not going to go into detail to explain who did throw…

Well we intend to get Milton in this series, don’t worry, but what we would like to do is have Joe Williams do it. Because Joe and Milton I’ve heard them together and they’re unbelievable, the stories they tell.
